name: Amsterdam
operatingHours: GVB metro runs ~6:00 AM–~12:30 AM daily (trams and buses similar). No all-night metro; GVB night buses run ~12:30–7:00 AM, and NS trains link Centraal and Schiphol hourly all night.
fareInfo: Tap a contactless bank card or phone (OVpay) on the gates to check in and out: €1.16 base + ~€0.22/km, so most city metro rides cost ~€2–3, capped at €10.50 per day on GVB (2026). Or buy a GVB 1-hour ticket (€3.40, transfers included) or a 24-hour pass (€10; 48 h €16, 72 h €21.50). GVB tickets don't cover the NS train to Schiphol (~€6.20 single, separate check-in at the yellow NS posts) or night buses (€5.70).

sights.name: Anne Frank House
sights.note: The canal-side house and secret annex where Anne Frank hid and wrote her diary during the Nazi occupation.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–10:00 PM daily (hours vary by season)

sights.name: Van Gogh Museum
sights.note: The world's largest Van Gogh collection, from the Potato Eaters to the Sunflowers, on Museumplein.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM daily, till 9:00 PM Fri

sights.name: Rijksmuseum
sights.note: The Dutch national museum, with Rembrandt's Night Watch, Vermeer's Milkmaid and eight centuries of Dutch art and history.

sights.name: Vondelpark
sights.note: Amsterdam's big 19th-century landscape park, full of cyclists, picnickers and summer open-air theatre.

sights.name: The Jordaan
sights.note: A former working-class quarter of narrow canals, hidden courtyards, brown cafés and the Saturday Noordermarkt.

sights.name: Heineken Experience
sights.note: Self-guided tour through Heineken's 1867 brewery building, ending with a tasting at the rooftop bar.
sights.hours: 10:30 AM–7:30 PM Sun–Thu, till 9:00 PM Fri & Sat (last entry 2 h before close)

sights.name: Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder
sights.note: A 17th-century canal house hiding a complete Catholic church in its attic, built when Catholic worship was banned.

sights.name: Museum Het Rembrandthuis
sights.note: Rembrandt's restored home and studio, with his etchings and live demonstrations of 17th-century printmaking.

sights.name: Body Worlds
sights.note: Gunther von Hagens' plastinated human bodies, arranged around the theme of health and happiness, on Damrak.

sights.name: A'DAM Lookout
sights.note: Observation deck atop the A'DAM Tower across the IJ, with a 360° view and a swing over the edge; free ferry from Centraal.

sights.name: Verzetsmuseum Amsterdam
sights.note: The Dutch Resistance Museum, telling everyday stories of collaboration, adaptation and resistance under German occupation.

sights.name: Albert Cuyp Market
sights.note: The city's biggest street market in De Pijp; come for fresh stroopwafels, herring and Dutch cheese.

sights.name: Dam Square
sights.note: The historic heart of the city, framed by the Royal Palace, the Nieuwe Kerk and the National Monument.

sights.name: ARTIS Amsterdam Royal Zoo
sights.note: One of Europe's oldest zoos, set among 19th-century buildings in the Plantage, with an aquarium and planetarium.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Mar–Oct, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Nov–Feb

sights.name: Royal Palace Amsterdam
sights.note: The 17th-century city hall turned royal palace on Dam Square, with a marble Citizens' Hall; still used for state occasions.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–5:00 PM most days; closed during royal events

sights.name: Begijnhof
sights.note: A quiet medieval courtyard of almshouses around a green, entered through a small door off Spui; free.

sights.name: Foodhallen
sights.note: An indoor food hall in a converted tram depot in Oud-West, with dozens of street-food stalls and bars.
sights.hours: ~11:00 AM–11:30 PM daily, later Fri & Sat

railStations.name: Amsterdam Centraal
railStations.note: Eurostar to Brussels, Paris (~3h20m) and London (~4h); ICE to Cologne and Frankfurt; Intercity trains across the Netherlands and to Schiphol. Metro lines 51–54 start here, and free ferries cross the IJ to Noord from the back of the station.
railStations.hours: Station open ~24 h (night trains hourly). Metro ~6:00 AM–~12:30 AM; mainline trains run to individual timetables, Eurostar check-in closes ~30–60 min before departure.

airports.name: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol
airports.transitNote: NS train from the station under Schiphol Plaza to Amsterdam Centraal in ~15–20 min (national rail, not on this metro map; ~€6.20, tap in with a contactless card at the yellow NS posts). Trains to Amsterdam Zuid take ~8 min for metro lines 50/51/52. Bus 397 to Museumplein/Leidseplein ~30 min.
airports.hours: NS trains run 24 h: every few minutes from ~5:30 AM to ~12:30 AM, then about hourly overnight.
